'''K-Com''' was a pair of [[Xiytiar-class heavy transport|''Xiytiar''-class heavy transports]] that were present at [[Camen Spaceport]] where the [[Hurrim]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Merte]], stolen by two members of [[Dunari]]'s coalition escaped the Hurrim's asteroid base under heavy pursuit of [[Preybird-class starfighter|Preybird]] starfighters. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] sent a strike force of two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] to cover the retreat. Until the shuttle reached hyperspace. K-Com's cargoes were Communication satellites and Communication computers.
